## See also

* [strazactl](/reference/cli/strazactl/): Straza admin CLI
* [strazactl apps bind](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_bind/): Give a role the server owns access to its tools (a tool without access does not exist for the role)
* [strazactl apps disable](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_disable/): Pause a server: stop it and keep it stopped until re-enabled
* [strazactl apps enable](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_enable/): Clear a server's admin pause and (re)start it
* [strazactl apps export](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_export/): Print a server's stored manifest as app.yaml on stdout, the document apps install takes
* [strazactl apps import](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_import/): Convert an MCP registry server.json into an App manifest, by the registry import rules of the app manifest specification
* [strazactl apps install](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_install/): Install or update MCP servers from app.yaml manifests
* [strazactl apps list](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_list/): List MCP servers with live status, the reason behind it and the roles that reach each
* [strazactl apps logs](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_logs/): Show recent runtime log lines for a server
* [strazactl apps recheck](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_recheck/): Trigger an immediate health probe and print the refreshed state
* [strazactl apps remove](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_remove/): Stop and remove a server
* [strazactl apps secret](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_secret/): Manage a server's static secret (injected gateway-side, never client-visible)
* [strazactl apps show](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_show/): Show one server in full: health and its reason, tools, who has access and how each tool runs, the stored secrets
* [strazactl apps tools](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_tools/): List exposed MCP tools with their upstream descriptions, every server or one
* [strazactl apps unbind](/reference/cli/strazactl/strazactl_apps_unbind/): Remove a role's access to a server (the id is in bindings list and apps show)
